classification.difficultyReason: Scale a known percentage amount to a different requested percentage, using the unitary method or a percentage ratio, including exact mixed percentages.

children.label: a
children.prompt: 20% of an amount of money is $\$46\,890$. What is 80% of the amount of money?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}20\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$46\,890\\1\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$46\,890\div20=\$2344.50\\80\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$2344.50\times80=\$187\,560\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: 5% of an amount of money is $\$42\,000$. What is 20% of the amount of money?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}5\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$42\,000\\1\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$42\,000\div5=\$8400\\20\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$8400\times20=\$168\,000\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: $12\frac{1}{2}\%$ of an amount of money is $\$64\,800$. What is the total amount of money?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}12\frac{1}{2}\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$64\,800\\1\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$64\,800\div12\frac{1}{2}=\$5184\\100\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$5184\times100=\$518\,400\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: $33\frac{1}{3}\%$ of an amount of money is $\$45\,000$. What is 60% of the amount of money?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}33\frac{1}{3}\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$45\,000\\1\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$45\,000\div\frac{100}{3}=\$1350\\60\%\text{ of the amount}&=\$1350\times60=\$81\,000\end{align*}$$
